en.title: DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget: Cute Real-time Balance Monitor for DeepSeek
en.hook: Keep an eye on your DeepSeek account balance with an interactive, bouncy desktop whale widget.
key_takeaways: Features a cute desktop companion widget on the bottom right of the DSH interface
Supports drag-and-drop snapping, flip animations, and smooth numeric scrolling
Lightweight open-source tool for developers to conveniently track API usage

zh.title: DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget: 监控 DeepSeek 账户余额的可爱桌面小鲸鱼插件
zh.hook: 在 DeepSeek 界面右下角放置一只Q弹的小鲸鱼，助你实时盯着账户余额。
key_takeaways: 常驻 DeepSeek 界面右下角的动态小鲸鱼伴侣
支持拖拽吸附、翻转特效及数字滚动动画，随界面自动启用
实用且生动的开源小工具，防止 API 额度耗尽时措手不及
